taxonomy.Mobile: The resource evaluates an agent operating a mobile-device interface or mobile-device emulator.
taxonomy.Computer-use: The resource evaluates an agent operating a browser, website, desktop GUI, or mobile-device interface.
taxonomy.CLI: The resource evaluates an agent operating through a command-line, shell, or terminal interface. No current catalog entry has sufficient source evidence for this tag.

records.name: VPI-Bench
records.evidence: The primary paper title identifies VPI-Bench as a benchmark for visual prompt-injection attacks on computer-use agents.

records.name: AdvWeb / ARE
records.evidence: Safety at Scale Table 14 records this benchmark's evaluation focus as adversarial robustness for multimodal web agents.

records.name: ST-WebAgentBench
records.evidence: The primary paper title defines ST-WebAgentBench as a benchmark for safety and trustworthiness in web agents.

records.name: WASP
records.evidence: The official repository identifies WASP as a web-agent security benchmark against prompt-injection attacks.

records.name: Refusal-Trained LLMs
records.evidence: The primary paper title explicitly studies refusal-trained language models acting as browser agents.

records.name: SafeArena
records.evidence: The official repository describes SafeArena as a benchmark for assessing the harmful capabilities of web agents.

records.name: MobileSafetyBench
records.evidence: The official project evaluates autonomous device-control agents in an Android-emulator environment.
